_meta.title: France: racist crimes and offences recorded by police and gendarmerie per 10,000 people, by département, yearly average 2022–2024
_meta.measures: Crimes and délits committed because of ethnicity, nation, alleged race or religion, recorded by the police and gendarmerie, per 10,000 inhabitants, yearly average 2022–2024, by place of offence, in three classes (fewer than 1.1, 1.1 to 2.1, more than 2.1). The note publishes the map only as classes; the class of each département was read from the colours of Figure 3. The note states: national average 1.2 per 10,000; Paris 3 to 4 times the national average; lowest Gers 0.4, then Dordogne, Haute-Loire and Lozère 0.5; Alpes-Maritimes in the 1.1–2.1 class (all of which the reading matches).
_meta.source: SSMSI (Ministry of the Interior statistical service), Interstats Info Rapide n° 49, March 2025, Figure 3; sources SSMSI recorded offences 2022–2024, Insee census 2021
_meta.licence: French public-sector information; the note states no licence (supplied by the site owner as a PDF)
